website.note: Corporate site describes OmniAb as an antibody-discovery technology platform. No proprietary clinical pipeline page; all clinical programs reside with partners.

ctgov.note: Zero OmniAb-sponsored interventional studies. OmniAb licenses its discovery platforms (OmniRat, OmniChicken, OmniFlic, OmniMouse, OmniDeep, xPloration, etc.) to partners who then run trials under their own sponsor names.

excluded_partner_owned.note: Per 10-K (FY2025, filed 2026-03-04): 107 active partners, 407 active programs using OmniAb technology, 27 OmniAb-derived antibodies in clinical development by partners, 2 under regulatory review, and 3 approved/commercialized by partners. All clinical assets are owned and run by third-party partners; OmniAb receives milestones/royalties only. Excluded per workflow rule 4 (partner-owned trials).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Services / CRO-style antibody-discovery platform company. OmniAb licenses its transgenic-animal and AI-driven discovery technologies to pharma/biotech partners and earns milestones/royalties; it does not own or sponsor clinical-stage drug assets. The 27 partner clinical programs derived from its tech are partner-owned and excluded per workflow rule 4.
